# Reading fixtures

These unchanged source/goal fixtures are retained from the
[recorded reader checks](https://github.com/flengyel/MRW/tree/af623be0a9dc85cb23dbdde610484ad886ea687a/docs/evidence).
They exercise navigation and presentation, not new mathematical verification.
The Equational Theories goal output is attributed to the project contributors
under Apache-2.0; the Euclid passage is historical public-domain mathematics.
The original provenance record is an external input to the historical host runner,
not bundled application data or a newly generated attestation.
